Differentiate the function to get f'(x). Set f'(x) = 0 and solve for x. These x-values are candidates for stationary points. Plug them back into the original function to get y-values. Then, use the second derivative test: if f''(x) > 0, it's a local minimum; if < 0, a local maximum.
